config.expression: if(coalesce({view.params.tagPath}, '') = '', '', case(toStr(coalesce(try(tag({view.params.tagPath} + '.TypeId'), ''), '')), 'Devices/Pump', 'Motor', 'Devices/Valve', 'Valve', 'Devices/Tank', 'Tank', 'Devices/Compressor', 'Comp', 'Devices/Evaporator', 'CG', 'Devices/ExhaustFan', 'EF', 'Devices/LTU', 'LTU', 'Devices/SafetyRelay', 'Relay', 'Devices/SuctionSequence', 'Seq', 'Devices/DischargeSequence', 'Dsq', 'Devices/Sensor', if(coalesce(try(toBoolean(tag({view.params.tagPath} + '/AIn.Enabled')), false), false), 'AIn', if(coalesce(try(toBoolean(tag({view.params.tagPath} + '/AInRef.Enabled')), false), false), 'AInRef', '')), 'Devices/DiscreteInput', if(coalesce(try(toBoolean(tag({view.params.tagPath} + '/DIn.Enabled')), false), false), 'DIn', ''), ''))

if(coalesce({view.params.tagPath}, '') = '', '', coalesce(try(lookup(tag('[default]_Config/Security/DeviceTypes'), toStr(coalesce(try(tag({view.params.tagPath} + '.TypeId'), ''), '')), null, 'TypeId', 'Device'), null), try(lookup(tag('[default]_Config/Security/DeviceTypes'), toStr(coalesce(try(tag(left({view.params.tagPath}, lastIndexOf({view.params.tagPath}, '/')) + '.TypeId'), ''), '')), null, 'TypeId', 'Device'), null), try(lookup(tag('[default]_Config/Security/DeviceTypes'), toStr(coalesce(try(tag(left(left({view.params.tagPath}, lastIndexOf({view.params.tagPath}, '/')), lastIndexOf(left({view.params.tagPath}, lastIndexOf({view.params.tagPath}, '/')), '/')) + '.TypeId'), ''), '')), null, 'TypeId', 'Device'), null), ''))
if(!coalesce({session.custom.ReadOnly}, true) && coalesce({view.custom.roCommand}, false), 'Not Permitted: ' + {view.custom.permDevice} + ' / ' + 'Command' + ' (Roles & Permissions)', '')

messageHandlers.script:
# Ticket Logger context-menu opener
	# page-scoped: every view on the page hears it - only the view whose menu was clicked acts
	sender = payload.get('sender')
	if sender and sender != self.view.id:
		return
	shared.Alerts.contextMenuTicketLog(payload['tagPath'], payload['viewName'])

config.script:
if self.view.custom.pax:
		return  # pax-bindings: live PLC object, read only
	if self.view.custom.roCommand:
		return  # security-tiers
	base = self.view.params.tagPath
	if not base:
		return
	val = self.getSibling('PositionEntry').props.value
	paths = [base + '/Cmd_Position/Value']
	vals = [float(val) if val is not None else 0.0]
	system.tag.writeBlocking(paths, vals)
